fusions.name: Musk Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of musk that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Glob
fusions.desc: Lobs a glob that deals 12 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stand-off Stance
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Not Twice
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 10% poison resistance.
